spec.name: Inbound lead
spec.goal: Qualify website enquiries and draft a reply for sales.
spec.label: ${{ inputs.email }}

research.title: Research the lead
research.instructions:
Find the sender's company, its size and what it likely needs.
Use web search and HubSpot reads. Contact nobody.

unqualified.when: Spam, students, job seekers or no fit.

draft_reply.instructions: Draft a short, warm reply in our voice that proposes a call.

spec.name: Weekly pipeline digest
spec.goal: Summarise open deals every Monday and flag the risky ones.

collect.title: Collect open deals
collect.instructions: List open HubSpot deals with stage, amount, close date and last activity. Mark deals with no activity in 14 days or a slipped close date as risky.

write.title: Write the digest
write.instructions: Write a short digest. Risky deals first, one line each with the reason and a next step.

spec.name: Meeting follow-up
spec.goal: Turn client meeting notes into a summary and Linear issues.

summarise.title: Summarise the meeting
summarise.instructions: Read the transcript. List decisions, open questions and action items with owners.

file.title: File action items
file.instructions: Create one Linear issue per action item in the client's project. Skip items already filed.

spec.name: Monthly profitability
spec.goal: Report project margins on the first of each month.

compute.title: Compute margins
compute.source:
import json
rows = json.load(open("input.json"))["projects"]
out = [{**r, "margin": (r["revenue"] - r["cost"]) / r["revenue"]} for r in rows if r["revenue"]]
json.dump({"projects": out}, open("output.json", "w"))

explain.title: Explain the month
explain.instructions: Explain which projects moved margin and why, in five bullets at most.

spec.name: Issue triage
spec.goal: Classify new GitHub issues, reproduce bugs and draft a response.
spec.label: ${{ inputs.title }}

classify.title: Classify the issue
classify.instructions: Read the issue and decide what it is.

reproduce.title: Reproduce the bug
reproduce.instructions: Check out the repository and try to reproduce the bug. Report the minimal steps.

respond.title: Draft a response
respond.instructions: Draft a reply on the issue. Thank the reporter and say what happens next.

spec.name: Competitor research
spec.goal: Profile each competitor and synthesise a comparison.

do.instructions: Profile the competitor from its website and recent news. Pricing, positioning, customers.

synthesise.title: Synthesise
synthesise.instructions: Compare the profiles in a table and list three openings for us.

spec.name: Content review loop
spec.goal: Draft a blog post, critique it until it is good, then publish to Notion.

write.title: Write the draft
write.instructions: Write or revise the post. Apply every point of the latest critique.

critique.title: Critique
critique.instructions: Critique the draft against our style guide. Accept only if nothing important is left.

spec.name: Client onboarding
spec.goal: Set up a new client's workspace and send the welcome pack before kickoff.
spec.label: ${{ inputs.client }}

welcome.title: Draft the welcome email
welcome.instructions: Draft a welcome email with the folder, page and project links and the kickoff date.

brief.title: Brief the team
brief.instructions: Write a one-page kickoff brief for the team.

spec.name: Alert triage
spec.goal: Investigate production alerts and page on-call only when it matters.
spec.label: ${{ inputs.alert_key }}

investigate.title: Investigate
investigate.instructions: Check logs, recent deploys and dashboards. Estimate severity and the likely cause.

spec.name: Quarterly board pack
spec.goal: Assemble the quarterly board pack from finance and delivery data.

gather.title: Gather numbers
gather.instructions: Collect revenue, margin and headcount for the quarter.

draft.title: Draft the pack
draft.instructions: Draft the board pack in our template.

spec.name: Renewal reminders
spec.goal: Remind account owners 30 days before a contract renews.

find.title: Find renewals
find.instructions: List contracts renewing in the next 30 days with their account owner.

run.title: Weekly channel readout
run.instructions: Summarize last week's channel contribution for Larkspur and flag any interval wider than 20%.

run.title: Overnight price test
run.instructions: Post the overnight price test readout.

run.title: Stale pull requests
run.instructions: List pull requests open for more than a week.
